surfaces.behavior: Select the intended plugin origin and version with compatibility and integrity context.
Canonical product source is semantically complete and generated views match it.
Package bytes and metadata exactly match the source-derived snapshot.
surfaces.blocker: omission, extra, private file, mode/link, or digest mismatch

surfaces.behavior: Installed tree matches the verified package in the selected plugin home.
surfaces.blocker: wrong home, partial install, stale or extra owned bytes

surfaces.behavior: Host cache resolves to the current installed plugin identity.
surfaces.blocker: stale, mixed, or unresolved cache identity

surfaces.behavior: Running host registers and exposes the intended front-door skill.
surfaces.blocker: source/install proof substituted for host behavior

surfaces.behavior: Discovered plugin loads current guidance and routes a representative fitted-repository task.
surfaces.independent_proof: new-task replay and external outcome check
surfaces.blocker: stale route, wrong command, missing skill load, or bypass

surfaces.behavior: Fit a new repository minimally and verify host plus routine behavior.
surfaces.blocker: generic scaffold, hidden write, or receipt-only verification

surfaces.behavior: Integrate with an existing repository while preserving user policy and workflows.
surfaces.blocker: overwrite, duplicate authority, or unverified compatibility

surfaces.behavior: Run the smallest legal changed-surface checks quickly on a dirty tree.
surfaces.blocker: affected-set miss, stale cache, hidden global work, or optional-service dependency

surfaces.behavior: Explain a causal failure and compile the smallest safe repair.
surfaces.blocker: guessed cause, raw receipt dump, unsafe or non-exact repair

surfaces.behavior: Execute or verify complete required same-candidate proof and compute a ceiling.
surfaces.independent_proof: false-pass, tamper, stale, wrong-surface, and no-cache suite
surfaces.blocker: self-validating, stale, narrow, or wrong-surface evidence

surfaces.behavior: Emit, persist, query, and explain privacy-safe local semantic events without external services.
surfaces.blocker: missing correlation, unbounded/private data, or wrong candidate

surfaces.behavior: Export and query required events through the selected OpenTelemetry/backend path when the claim requires it.
surfaces.independent_proof: backend query matched to local operation
surfaces.blocker: drop, mismatch, delay beyond policy, or source-local substitution

surfaces.behavior: Derive, execute, reconcile, review, and recover an adaptive product work graph.
surfaces.blocker: fixed lanes, semantic conflict, worker self-acceptance, or unrecoverable partial state

surfaces.behavior: Refresh current primary authority, classify it correctly, and trace proposed product law without self-adoption.
surfaces.validator: planned: source provenance, classification, drift, and requirement-trace validator
surfaces.independent_proof: independent primary-source retrieval and complete source-to-blocker join
surfaces.blocker: stale, secondary-as-primary, synthesis-substituted, unmapped, or self-adopted source claim

surfaces.behavior: Convert a reconciled failure into a validated, independently promoted improvement.
surfaces.independent_proof: validated baseline/candidate replay with negative controls
surfaces.blocker: broken eval, self-score, contamination, or wrong-surface promotion

surfaces.behavior: Plan, apply, verify, and if needed roll back upgrades, cleanup, and retirement.
surfaces.independent_proof: upgrade, rollback, cleanup, and package/app absence checks
surfaces.blocker: deletion before replacement proof or residual duplicate authority

surfaces.behavior: Issue only the minimum independently reconciled integrated claim ceiling.
surfaces.blocker: any required unknown, stale, invalid, blocked, or lower-ceiling surface
